pool_assignment: pool windows are assigned to run-in (150 healthy), unlabelled and labelled sets by numpy.random.default_rng(2026) in data._assemble; the run-in set is split 75/75 per seed in run_grid.eval_cls

cwru.unit: one recording per class, fault size and load (12 kHz drive-end and normal-baseline files)
cwru.source_segments: first 70% train (last window dropped), 70-85% validation (last window dropped), 85-100% calibration
cwru.target_segments: first 45% pool (run-in, unlabelled and labelled windows), 45-50% guard gap, 50-100% test
cwru.windows: 1024 samples, hop 512 on train/pool segments, hop 1024 on validation, calibration and test segments
